subterranean_levels.1000_hpa: ALWAYS subterranean at Nuolja (p_sfc <= 952.2 hPa). ql and qi are 0.0 or fill, but naive trapezoid adds 75 hPa layer mass.
subterranean_levels.925_hpa: Subterranean when p_sfc < 925 hPa (e.g. low pressure systems). Truncation/interpolation required.
subterranean_levels.850_hpa: ALWAYS atmospheric above surface at Nuolja (p_sfc > 850 hPa).

integration_method.nature: Discrete numerical trapezoidal approximation (NOT physically exact)
integration_method.surface_truncation_rule: Integrate from p_top (50 hPa) down to p_sfc. Linearly interpolate q at p_sfc from nearest levels if p_sfc lies between discrete pressure levels. Zero weight to p > p_sfc.

gating_conditions: Feature extraction MUST use surface-aware integration (surface_air_pressure from sfc product).
No full extraction until integration pipeline incorporates surface pressure boundary truncation.
Minimal candidate feature set: lwp_latest, iwp_latest, lwp_x_cloud (cloud_water_total dropped due to linear redundancy).
